errors.text: The proposed Al2O3 or TiO2 coating is not supported by any of the cited evidence; none of E1-E3 studies an oxidation-resistant coating on HfNbTaTiZr.
The intervention is insufficiently specified: coating chemistry, thickness, deposition method, adhesion, thermal-expansion compatibility, and stability under thermal cycling are left undefined.
The falsification experiment measures scale thickness but omits quantitative oxidation kinetics and does not distinguish barrier failure, spallation, interdiffusion, or substrate oxygen uptake.
